changelog:
Initial release—completely redefined skill focus:

- Skill now introduces the cultural, historical, mathematical, and scientific meanings of number 0 (零) in both Chinese and English.
- Includes Chen Lang’s (陈朗) personal profile and a detailed overview of his OpenClaw project ecosystem.
- Covers symbolism and significance of zero in Eastern and Western cultures, usage in expressions, and connection to Chen Lang’s philosophy and work.
- Provides resource sections supporting both cultural research and personal interest in digital and AI projects centered on “starting from zero”.
